title: Editorial spread / Create better campaigns
slide_intent: Balance an explanation with a human example because readers need both the proposition and evidence of its relevance.
strategic_value: The founder photograph and orderly text can make Mailchimp’s service story feel credible without abandoning yellow or illustration.
demonstration: A photographed open spread pairs a large headline, columns and small illustrations on the left with a framed portrait and quotation on yellow at right.
practical_value: Compare the roles of headline, editorial explanation and customer imagery in a spread.

content_islands.name: Left page
content_islands.spec: Place the large serif headline above columns and a narrow set of illustrated points.

content_islands.name: Right page
content_islands.spec: Frame the portrait above its quotation on a yellow page with a large folio at the foot.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity is applied to an editorial spread combining text, photography and small illustrations.
